name: shan-farm-order
description: Shan Farm ordering flow: pick a pickup location, add two products, stop at Order Summary for human review. Recorded and verified 2026-08-10 against dev2-shan-farm-ordering.netlify.app.
notes: Replay with run_script, passing 'vars' below. There is deliberately NO Place Order step - the script ends at Order Summary so a human decides.

LOGIN is not scripted: the Google OAuth session must already exist in the browser. Sign in interactively once; afterwards the site shows a 'Welcome back / Continue to Order' interstitial, which step 2 handles.

GATE: 'Continue to Order' and 'Add & Checkout' match the destructive-action regex (order/checkout), so each replay asks for approval twice. Approve them, or run the server with BROWSER_AGENT_GATE=off for a flow that provably never places an order.
WAITS: the product catalog is detected via the search input's SELECTOR, not its text - placeholder text never appears in document.body.innerText, so a text wait_for can never match it.

DRAG is coordinate-based: the slide-to-confirm handle has no label. Values assume a ~2000px-wide viewport with the modal centred. Both slide steps are optional so the script works for public locations that skip the private-premises modal.
QUANTITIES stay at 1 per product: the +/- buttons have no text or aria-label to target. Adding aria-labels on the site would make quantities scriptable (and improve accessibility).

SITE BUG FOUND 2026-08-10: pickup location 'Test Event' has no products. Selecting its card directly shows 'No Products Available', but entering via the card's arrow -> Private Premises -> slide-to-confirm silently proceeds and the order ends up assigned to 'ViTrox AgriTech Experience Centre'. Two entry points to the same card give different outcomes.
